title: Titanium Chlorine Compressor Impeller
alloyReason: Grade 12 Ti-0.3Mo-0.8Ni (UNS R53400) is selected for Titanium Chlorine Compressor Impeller in chemical processing environments where resistance to HCl and H₂SO₄ at temperatures up to 200°C exceeds the capability of CP grades. The molybdenum and nickel additions stabilize the passive film under reducing acid conditions, extending service life in Wet chlorine gas compressor impeller by 3-5× versus unalloyed titanium. This rationale is driven by wet chlorine gas compressor impeller and service environment demands.
process: Hot forming plate rolling for reactor hardware geometry
CNC corrosion allowance with Class 6g gauge
TIG welding Grade 2 with Class 6g gauge
Hydrostatic shell test with Class 6g gauge
surfaceTreatment: Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming — tailored for wet chlorine gas application
commonFailures: Galvanic acceleration at Ti-steel weld joint - controlled by PTFE insulating gasket + CP adjustment — critical for wet chlorine gas performance

faq.q: What inspection and testing is available for Titanium Chlorine Compressor Impeller pressure-containing components?
faq.a: Titanium Chlorine Compressor Impeller can be supplied with hydrostatic pressure testing at 1.3× design pressure per ASME B31.3, PMI (positive material identification) via OES analyzer on 100% of production, ultrasonic wall thickness scanning, and helium leak testing to 1×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s. For wet chlorine gas, 100% PMI + hydrostatic testing is the standard specification.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Chlorine Compressor Impeller orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Chlorine Compressor Impeller is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Chlorine Compressor Impeller?
faq.a: Each Titanium Chlorine Compressor Impeller shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for wet chlorine gas.
